source: Authored for S04 (Issue #91) from the fail-closed identity rule in docs/architecture/connection.md#security-identity: a saved SPKI pin is compared before the token is placed on the wire, and a changed television identity closes the connection. Not captured from a physical television.
redaction: Contains no address, MAC, Wi-Fi name, certificate, serial, account or personal identifier, and no token value of any kind: the case is precisely that no token may be sent when the identity does not match. The handshake is refused before any frame is spoken.
notes: Second connection on the adopted TLS remote channel with a saved pairing, but the television now presents a different SubjectPublicKeyInfo. The saved-pin check fails the handshake, the session reports NeedsRepair with IdentityChanged, and the recorded connection attempt carries no saved token. Proves identityMismatchDoesNotSendToken and the fail-closed identity rule.
